"""Recompute all saved V161 EMA outputs using the exact current inputs and metrics."""
import os,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np,psutil,torch
from balanced_spatial_metrics import DetailMetrics,summarize
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2'
output=root/'baseline-V161-current-metrics-v1.json';protocol=root/'baseline-V161-current-metrics-protocol-v1.json'
assert not output.exists() and not protocol.exists()
os.nice(10);os.sched_setaffinity(0,[4,5]);torch.set_num_threads(2);torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');old_path=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1/scores-v1.json';old=read(old_path)
design=read(plan['design']['path'])['observations'];previous=read(old['design']['path'])['observations']
assert old['metric_sources']==plan['metrics_sources'] and len(previous)==len(design)==822
for a,b in zip(previous,design,strict=True):
 for key in ['id','arrays','parent','ROI_xywh','kind','cohort','noise','variant','output_shape']:assert a.get(key)==b.get(key),(a['id'],key)
owner=dict(pid=os.getpid(),created=psutil.Process().create_time())
save(protocol,dict(status='fixed-all822-existing-V161-EMA-array-reduction-before-V175-quality',owner=owner,old_scores=ref(old_path),old_review=old['review'],old_design=old['design'],current_design=plan['design'],metric_sources=plan['metrics_sources'],source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,scope='Previously strongest learned-detail baseline;all822 original V161 EMA full arrays already exist on exactly the same cached inputs/parents/ROIs. Recompute established metrics and compare common original values,not new model inference or new quality selection.'))
metric=DetailMetrics(plan['metrics_sources']);lookup={r['id']:r for r in old['rows'] if r['method']=='harmonic-context-EMA-step1000'}
assert len(lookup)==822
rows=[];checks=channels=bytes_read=0;maximum=0.
for index,case in enumerate(design):
 assert psutil.virtual_memory().available>32*2**30
 original=lookup[case['id']]
 for binding in [case['arrays'],case['parent'],original['prediction']]:assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
 arrays=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));base=np.load(case['parent']['path']);value=np.load(original['prediction']['path'])
 row=metric.measure(case,arrays,base,value)
 for key,number in row.items():
  if isinstance(number,(int,float)) and not isinstance(number,bool) and key in original:
   delta=abs(number-original[key]);assert delta<1e-10,(case['id'],key,delta);maximum=max(maximum,delta);checks+=1
 row.update(method='V161-EMA',source_method=original['method'],index=index,prediction=original['prediction'],values=fingerprint(value))
 rows.append(row);channels+=value.size;bytes_read+=Path(original['prediction']['path']).stat().st_size
 if (index+1)%100==0:print('Checked old V161 EMA arrays',index+1,flush=True)
assert len(rows)==822 and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(output,dict(status='pass-all822-existing-V161-EMA-arrays-on-identical-current-inputs-and-metrics',protocol=ref(protocol),owner=owner,old_scores=ref(old_path),old_review=old['review'],design=plan['design'],metric_sources=plan['metrics_sources'],rows=rows,summary=summarize(rows),common_original_scalar_checks=checks,maximum_original_scalar_difference=maximum,old_RGB_channels_checked=channels,old_prediction_array_bytes=bytes_read,new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope='All822 saved old V161 EMA arrays rehashed/reduced against exactly the same current cached noisy inputs,parents and ROIs with identical metric-source bytes. No V161,V175,parent,DINO or sampling model forward;no new noise/source draws;real references remain unscored. This strengthens the numerical comparison with the earlier detail prototype without claiming new V175 quality.'))
print('PASS822 old V161 EMA arrays;',checks,'common original scalars;maxdiff',maximum,';zero inference/noise',flush=True)
